slot_scores.name: purchase_at_month_start
slot_scores.evidence_quote: When you sell units in a given month, do they have to come from the stock on hand at the start of that month (i.e., you cannot sell units you purchase in the same month), or can units bought in a month also be sold in that same month?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked about same-month purchase/sale timing, which is related to intra-month timing, but did not explicitly ask whether purchases occur at the beginning of the month as required by the hidden slot.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Purchases occur at the beginning of each month, so inventory balance can be modeled as I_m = I_{m-1} + x_m - s_m with same-month purchases available for sale.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never explicitly confirmed the beginning-of-month purchase timing; it only confirmed that units bought in a month can be sold in the same month, which does not fully resolve when purchases occur relative to the sales period.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL without fully resolving the P1 hidden slot about purchase timing within the month.

summary: The agent asked several useful clarifying questions and resolved most modeling details, but it only partially addressed the timing of purchases within the month and then stopped with that P1 issue unresolved.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
